title: Manifest - Toz Pembe | Dance Tutorial Explained Step by Step

observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

extraction.teacher_style: The teacher explains the choreography step by step with cheerful encouragement and personal commentary. She frequently links movements to song lyrics and breaks down complex counts into simple directional cues.

lesson_structure.note: Introduction to the song Toz Pembe and the choreography.
Step-by-step breakdown of the first movement phrase.

steps_taught.name: bakıyorsun step
steps_taught.description: Step to the side with arm positioning and hip drop.

what_works: breaking down lyrics alongside physical movement
repetition of steps from the beginning
what_hinders: the instructor faces away from the camera for most of the explanation

quotes.text: Bugün sizlerle Manifest'in son şarkısı olan Toz Pembe'nin koreografisini öğrenmek için buradayız.
Şarkı bakıyorsun diye çok toz pembe diye giriyor.

evidence_segments.observation: Instructor stands in front of a mirror talking to the camera.
Instructor demonstrates foot step and arm placement facing away towards the mirror.

extraction.distinctive_method: Integrating song lyrics directly into the physical timing and verbal explanations.
